eye_audit.read: REAL 7 of 7 public, SMITH 10 (spread over families) plus the insertion context of 2 per family, CLEAN 10
found_and_fixed: business_3m / retroactive bases included budget acts and street renamings (the rule engine's burden detector is loose): now a base needs a money burden outside budget, naming and implementing-act titles
duplicate_clause copied clauses between unrelated acts: now needs the same topic (title similarity 0.25-0.9)
inserted clauses were appended after the signature and footer (a visible tell); then they split the last clause at 'viloyat hokimining': now they go after the last clause's own sentence end
one CLEAN text was 627 000 characters (annex tables): texts over 45 000 characters and texts with leaked lex.uz page code are excluded from every split except REAL
form_farmoyish gold span carried a label that is not in the text: now the new registration number only
known_weaknesses: business_3m N and retroactive N are tiny (the engine finds few genuine burdens without a stated entry into force)
SMITH is Latin-script only; REAL and CLEAN also hold Cyrillic texts, a possible shortcut
an inserted clause is a stylistic tell for a model that compares with real decisions
double_repeal reuses a few repealed targets; CLEAN is small because few old decisions survive the filters

rules: Never train on audit_v1. Changing an instance, the grader, a tool or either store = v1.1 and every model re-runs. SMITH is synthetic and always reported as such. Private items are in data/bench/private/ (never published, never given to a model that is being trained). Flagged means possible violation.
